newsitem.title: ITALY: Four drown in Turkish shipwreck off Italy.
newsitem.headline: Four drown in Turkish shipwreck off Italy.

text.p: A Turkish freighter sank in the Mediterranean Sea off the Italian island of Sicily on Wednesday and four of its 11 crew drowned, port officials said.
Another crew member was missing, they said.
The officials said the 1,800 tonne "Onurk" sank between the western Sicilian town of Trapani and the port of Cagliari on the island of Sardinia at about 3 a.m. (0200 GMT) in stormy weather.
Five crew members were rescued from the sinking freighter by a ship in the area and a sixth was plucked from a lifeboat by a rescue helicopter dispatched by port officials in Palermo.
Four others were found dead in the water and the search for the one missing crew member was continuing, the officials said.
